# American Academy of Family Physicians (AAFP)

> AAFP is the professional home for 124,500 family physicians, providing peer-reviewed clinical journals, CME education, advocacy, and conferences to advance family medicine practice.

The AAFP represents the largest medical specialty organization focused on family medicine in the United States. The organization publishes multiple peer-reviewed journals (AFP, FPM, FP Essentials), offers continuing medical education with AMA and international CME credit equivalencies, and hosts major annual conferences for professional development.

## Key Topics

- Family Medicine
- Continuing Medical Education (CME)
- American Family Physician (AFP) Journal
- AMA PRA Category 1 Credit
- Peer-Reviewed Clinical Content
- Medical Conferences
- Clinical Practice Guidelines
- Professional Development
- Physician Advocacy
- Telemedicine
- Patient-Centered Care
- CME Credit Equivalency
- Medical Education
- Clinical Monographs
- Healthcare Policy

## Peer-Reviewed Publications

- [AFP | AAFP](https://www.aafp.org/pubs/afp.html): American Family Physician peer-reviewed clinical journal with CME credits
- [FP Essentials | Monthly Clinical Monographs | AAFP](https://www.aafp.org/pubs/fpe.html): FP Essentials peer-reviewed monthly clinical monographs with CME credits
- [FPM | AAFP](https://www.aafp.org/pubs/fpm.html): Family Practice Management peer-reviewed practice improvement journal

## Continuing Medical Education

- [Family Medicine Update Edition 6 | AAFP](https://www.aafp.org/cme/all/family-medicine-update/self-study.html): Family Medicine Update online CME course on current clinical topics
- [Other Credit Equivalency/Agreements | AAFP](https://www.aafp.org/cme/credit-system/credit-statements/health-professional-organizations-agreement.html): AAFP CME credit equivalency agreements with AMA and other organizations
- [Other Credit Equivalency/Agreements | AAFP](https://www.aafp.org/cme/credit-system/credit-statements/cfpc-agreement.html): AAFP CME credit equivalency agreements with international healthcare organizations
- [Cancellations and Course Refunds | AAFP](https://www.aafp.org/cme/about/cancellations-refunds.html): AAFP cancellation and refund policy for courses and events

## Annual Conferences & Events

- [FUTURE 2026 | Formerly National Conference for Family Medicine | AAFP](https://www.aafp.org/events/national-conference/scholarships.html): FUTURE 2026 family medicine conference in Kansas City (July 30-Aug 1)
- [Whole Health Summit | AAFP](https://www.aafp.org/events/whole-health-summit.html): Whole Health Summit in Charlotte, NC (May 17-19) for family physicians

## Clinical Reference & Topics

- [Topic | AAFP](https://www.aafp.org/pubs/afp/topics/by-topic.inpatient-medicine.html): AFP clinical reference topics organized by inpatient medicine categories
- [Taxonomy | AAFP](https://www.aafp.org/pubs/afp/collections/taxonomy.fractures.html): AFP taxonomy collection for fractures and medical condition classification

## Policy & Practice Positions

- [Retail Clinics | AAFP](https://www.aafp.org/about/policies/all/retail-clinics.html): AAFP policy position on retail clinics for patient-centered healthcare

## News & Health Insights

- [Obstructive Sleep Apnea Screening Evidence Insufficient | AAFP](https://www.aafp.org/news/health-of-the-public/obstructive-sleep-apnea-2022-draft.html): USPSTF draft recommendation on sleep apnea screening evidence
- [Inside Look at Using Telemedicine During COVID-19 Pandemic | AAFP](https://www.aafp.org/news/health-of-the-public/20200323covidtelehealth.html): AAFP guidance on telehealth implementation during COVID-19 pandemic
- [Survey Outlines FPs' Challenges on COVID-19 Vaccines | AAFP](https://www.aafp.org/news/health-of-the-public/covid-vaccine-survey.html): AAFP survey on family physician confidence and challenges with COVID-19 vaccines
- [Cannabis Use in Older Adults Continues Upward Trend | AAFP](https://www.aafp.org/news/health-of-the-public/20200304cannabisuse.html): Analysis of cannabis use trends among older adults from national survey data
